name: Identity Management Demonstration
description: Use RemoteJuggler's own identity management tools to demonstrate the product. List available identities, detect the identity for the remote-juggler repo, check GPG signing status, audit recent credential access, and write a status report to a GitHub Discussion showing RemoteJuggler working on itself.
process: This task demonstrates RemoteJuggler's core value: multi-identity git management
Use juggler_setec_list to see what secrets are available
Use juggler_audit_log to review recent credential access patterns
Use juggler_resolve_composite to resolve a credential from multiple sources
Write a GitHub Discussion post with the actual tool outputs showing the system in action

metrics.successCriteria: Used 3+ identity/secret management tools with real output in a Discussion post
